environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on ECS Fargate in a VPC with access to internal services and the EC2 metadata endpoint. The Split.io feature flag 'enable_outbound_webhooks' is set to treatment 'on' for all users (100% rollout). The task role has broad network egress permissions. No egress filtering or URL validation is applied.

config.network: VPC with unrestricted egress, IMDSv1 enabled on metadata endpoint
